services.name: planner
services.summary: Stateless HTTP API that scores objects and routes a plan; also serves the static web frontend.
services.failure_policy: No retries server-side: every request is idempotent, the browser retries. Firestore read failure returns 503 store_unavailable. A museum's objects and graph are cached in memory for CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.

env.name: STORE_BACKEND
env.description: firestore or file. file is for offline tests only.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
env.description: Project that owns the Firestore database. Required when STORE_BACKEND=firestore.

env.name: FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST
env.description: Local only. Points the client at the emulator.

env.name: FILE_STORE_DIR
env.description: Local only. Directory read when STORE_BACKEND=file.

env.name: CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
env.description: How long an instance keeps a museum in memory.

services.name: ingestion-job
services.summary: Runs to completion: drains ingest-museum messages, pulls each named museum's open API, normalizes, writes Firestore.
services.failure_policy: A message is acked only after its museum is fully written. Invalid messages are logged and acked so they cannot poison the queue. Any museum failure makes the job exit non-zero; Cloud Run retries the task once and unacked messages are redelivered. The museum document is written last, so a failed run never points readers at half-written chunks.

env.name: STORE_BACKEND
env.description: firestore or file. file is for offline tests only.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
env.description: Project that owns Firestore and Pub/Sub. Required unless STORE_BACKEND=file and MUSEUM_ID is set.

env.name: MUSEUM_ID
env.description: If set, ingest only this museum and do not touch Pub/Sub.

env.name: SOURCE_MODE
env.description: live calls the museum API. fixture reads bundled raw payloads.

env.name: MAX_OBJECTS
env.description: Cap on plannable objects written per museum.

env.name: REFRESH_AFTER_HOURS
env.description: Museums ingested longer ago than this are refreshed on any run. 0 disables.

env.name: FILE_STORE_DIR
env.description: Local only. Directory written when STORE_BACKEND=file.

resources.name: ingest-museum
resources.notes: Publishing a message that names a museum id adds or refreshes that museum. No redeploy.

resources.name: ingest-museum-job
resources.notes: Pull subscription on ingest-museum, ack deadline 600s, drained by ingestion-job at the start of every execution.

resources.name: (default)
resources.notes: Native mode. Collections: museums/{id}, museums/{id}/object_chunks/{nnnn}, floor_graphs/{id}. ingestion-job is the only writer; planner only reads.

resources.name: ingest-tick
resources.notes: Every 10 minutes, starts an ingestion-job execution as scheduler-sa. An execution with nothing to do exits in seconds.
